ready3_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the schematic diagram of electric energy transmission of a small hydropower station, the generator supplies power to a pure-resistance electrical appliance with R0=11 Ω through the step-up transformer T1 and the step-down transformer T2. It is known that the total resistance of the transmission line is R=10 Ω, the turns ratio of the primary and secondary coils of T2 is 4∶1, and the voltage across the electrical appliance is u=220sin 100πt(V). Treat both T1 and T2 as ideal transformers. Find the input power of the step-down transformer T2.
ready3_open_rewrite.raw_answer: The input power of the step-down transformer is 4 400 W
ready3_open_rewrite.raw_standard_answer: The input power of the step-down transformer is 4 400 W

It is known that the total resistance of the transmission line is R=10 Ω, the turns ratio of the primary and secondary coils of T2 is 4∶1, and the voltage across the electrical appliance is u=220sin 100πt(V). Treat both T1 and T2 as ideal transformers. Find the input power of the step-down transformer T2.
ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: The input power of the step-down transformer is 4 400 W
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure, on the left is the generator, connected to the primary coil of the step-up transformer T1; the secondary coil of T1 is connected to the primary coil of the step-down transformer T2 on the right through the transmission-line resistance marked R above; the secondary coil of T2 is directly connected to the pure-resistance load R0 on the right.
Then reason: The problem gives R0=11 Ω, and the voltage across the load uses the effective value U0=220 V according to the specified method. The load is a pure resistance, so its average power is P0=U0^2/R0=220^2/11=4400 W. Since T2 is an ideal transformer, the input power equals the output power; therefore, the input power of the step-down transformer T2 is 4400 W.
